## Summary

Summary of the 8-K filed November 4, 2024. Cited figures are marked; the original filing is the authoritative source.

Franklin Resources, Inc. reported preliminary results for its fourth fiscal quarter and fiscal year ended September 30, 2024, in a press release furnished under Items 2.02 and 7.01 of this Form 8-K.

The company posted a preliminary net loss of $84.7 milliona, or **$0.19** per diluted share, for the quarter, compared with net income of **$174.0 million**, or **$0.32** per diluted share, in the prior quarter and **$295.5 million**, or **$0.58** per diluted share, in the year-ago quarter. The loss was driven by a **$389.2 million** impairment of an indefinite-lived intangible asset related to certain mutual fund contracts managed by Western Asset Management. Preliminary operating loss was **$150.7 million** for the quarter.

For the fiscal year, preliminary net income was $464.8 millionb, or **$0.85** per diluted share, versus **$882.8 million**, or **$1.72** per diluted share, in fiscal 2023. On a supplemental non-GAAP basis, adjusted net income was **$315.2 million**, or **$0.59** per diluted share, for the quarter, and **$1,276.7 million**, or **$2.39** per diluted share, for the fiscal year. Operating revenues rose to **$2,211.2 million** for the quarter, up **11%** year over year, and **$8,478.0 million** for the fiscal year, up **8%**.

Ending AUM reached a record $1,678.6 billionc at September 30, 2024, up **22%** from a year earlier. Fiscal-year long-term net outflows were **$32.6 billion**, including **$48.6 billion** of outflows at Western Asset Management, and the company cited a **25%** increase in long-term inflows to **$319 billion**. Management also highlighted the Putnam Investments acquisition, which closed January 1, 2024, with Putnam AUM growing **21%** to **$180 billion** and cost savings exceeding the **$150 million** run-rate target.

## Summary

Summary of the 8-K filed November 7, 2025. Cited figures are marked; the original filing is the authoritative source.

Franklin Resources, Inc. reported preliminary results for its fourth fiscal quarter and fiscal year ended September 30, 2025, in a press release attached as Exhibit 99.1 to this Form 8-K filed November 7, 2025.

For the quarter, net income attributable to Franklin Resources was $117.6 milliona, or **$0.21** per diluted share, compared with **$92.3 million**, or **$0.15** per diluted share, in the prior quarter and a net loss of **$84.7 million**, or **$0.19** per diluted share, in the year-ago quarter.
